name: ahaE2RDocumentAIv1
description: Document AI schema definition (v1) for extracting structured data from email ATTACHMENTS (PDF / image) into aha_E2R_Record__c. Generic, illustrative starter set — extend or replace properties to match your document types. NOTE: This is a source-of-truth design spec, NOT deployable DX metadata. Recreate it in the Data 360 'document schema builder' (Setup > Data 360 / Data Cloud > Document AI) or POST it via the Data 360 Connect REST API. See README.md.

documentType.title: documentType
documentType.description: What kind of document this is (e.g. 'Invoice', 'Application Form', 'Letter', 'Statement'). Infer from layout, headings, and content. Leave blank if genuinely unclear.

summary.title: summary
summary.description: A brief one- or two-sentence summary of what the document is about.
